item.title: Version 1.13.0
item.description:
More ways to read a chart

New chart ranges, a few tools traders asked for, and smoother charts.

  • New ranges: 3M, 6M, YTD and 5Y on the symbol chart and the portfolio chart. YTD starts from last year's final close; 5Y uses weekly closes. Thanks to Mo (@hamidi-dev).
  • Change over the range. Next to today's move, the symbol chart shows how much the price changed over the selected range.
  • Drag to measure. Click and drag across a chart to see the change between two dates.
  • Your average price on the chart. A holding's chart draws a dashed line at your average purchase price.
  • Smoother charts. Moving the mouse over a chart uses about 60% less CPU.
  • No more endless spinner when Yahoo does not return a price history.
